outputs.explanation: Panel A includes bar graphs (below the western blots) showing mean ± SD band intensity quantification for nuclear, cytosolic, and mitochondrial fractions (N=4). These are bar charts of averaged data, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars, so the underlying replicate values are not visible.
Panel B consists of immunoelectron micrographs; there is no plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel C is a western blot showing HMGB1 detection across different mitochondrial purification methods; it contains no quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a western blot showing proteinase K protection assay results; it contains no plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
